Albertslund is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation, specifically focusing on Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulation (AC) treatment using data from the Danish Stroke Database (DanStroke) and the National Patient Register (LPR) [^src1]. 

As one of the 98 Danish municipalities analyzed in the report, Albertslund's local data on stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is included in the detailed breakdowns used for local quality development and healthcare benchmarking [^src1]. The municipality's specific statistical outcomes for Indicator 5 are recorded in the report's municipal data tables [^src1]. Because Albertslund is only mentioned in this specific tabular context within the provided corpus, no further historical, relational, or demographic details are available.
